name: dsh-skin-pixel-anime
description: Pixel dynamic starfield theme for DeepSeek Harness: five palettes, four layered text schemes, five pixel fonts (one covering simplified Chinese), corner presets, a rotating pixel starfield with meteors, and a pixel clock — all configurable from its settings tab. · DeepSeek Harness 像素动态星空主题：五套配色、四套分层文字方案、五款像素字体（含简体中文像素字体）、方角/圆角可选、旋转像素星空与流星、像素时钟，均在设置页配置。
author: longgege-cd
